game.name: Guitar Hero : Metallica (USA, Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,It)
game.desc: Like Aerosmith before it, the band Metallica is at the centre of its own Guitar Hero game on Xbox 360. Whether behind the microphone, guitar, bass or drums, the player revisits the repertoire of the famous band. Other bands are also invited to lend a hand to the "metalheads".
